body:
Source: repository maintenance audit (test-suite bloat review, headline recommendation). 2,535 try/finally blocks and hundreds of hand-rolled git/tmp/spawn helpers exist across test files because no canonical test-kit exists.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Create packages/core/lib/test-kit.mjs exporting tmp(t, prefix), gitRepo(t, options), and runBin(binPath, args, options).
2. tmp(t, prefix) creates a temp directory and registers cleanup via t.after(() => rmSync(...)) when t?.after is available.
3. gitRepo(t, options) creates an isolated git repository with standard user credentials and git config under tmp(t).
4. runBin(binPath, args, options) runs a Node binary with sanitized environment variables (scrubbing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, bypass flags, etc.).
5. Export subpath './test-kit' from packages/core/package.json and declare types.
6. Add unit tests in packages/core/test/test-kit.test.mjs.
7. Keep packages/core test suite green and mutation-gate green.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Test-kit unit tests pass. verify: `node --test packages/core/test/test-kit.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC2 Export subpath resolves. verify: `node -e "import('@adlc/core/test-kit').then(m => { if (!m.tmp || !m.gitRepo || !m.runBin) process.exit(1); console.log('test-kit exports ok'); })"` prints `test-kit exports ok`.
- AC3 Cleanup verified: a test running tmp(t) leaves no directory on disk after completion.
- AC4 Package suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/core` exits 0.
- AC5 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0.
title: feat(core): introduce shared test-kit module with t.after automated cleanup
